summary: KANZHUN LIMITED (Kanzhun Ltd, HKEX: 02076) filed a Form 6-K containing its routine monthly return for equity issuers and Hong Kong Depositary Receipts movements for the month ended September 30, 2026. The filing discloses a net increase of 8,850,242 Class A ordinary shares, offset by a decrease of 12,345,920 Class B ordinary shares, leaving 940,266,324 ordinary shares outstanding. The weighted voting rights structure remains intact, with 829,269,523 Class A and 110,996,801 Class B shares. This is a standard post-issuance movement report, not a special situation. No special-situation event, price, stake, or deal terms are stated.
